technical_and_design_decisions: All new and modified modules will target Spring Framework 6.0+ and Java 17+ as the baseline runtime, aligned with the specification's stated requirement.
The SFTP source module (U7) will implement the standard Spring Cloud Stream Source interface to ensure compatibility with existing streaming pipeline configurations.
The YARN deployer (U2) will reuse existing Spring Cloud Data Flow YARN deployer core logic to minimize redundant implementation effort and ensure consistency with existing deployer patterns.
The build lifecycle split (U4) will use Maven profile-based modularization to avoid duplicating build logic for individual deployer bundles.
The XDRuntimeException replacement (U5) will use Spring's generic RuntimeException and DataAccessException hierarchies where appropriate to align with Spring's standard error handling conventions.
CI pipeline improvements (U8) will be built on the existing Jenkins infrastructure used by the Spring open source projects to avoid new tooling onboarding overhead.
assumptions: Baseline code for the legacy XD file module (U3) is accessible in the public Spring XD repository for reference during porting, with no licensing restrictions preventing reuse.
The target Maven snapshot repository (repo.spring.io/libs-snapshot) has existing write access configured for the development team, no additional access provisioning is required.
A test Hadoop YARN cluster is available for integration testing of the YARN deployer (U2) throughout the development cycle, with no scheduling conflicts.
The latest release of the Gemfire sink is compatible with Spring Cloud Stream 4.x, the version used for the current Spring Cloud Data Flow increment.
Existing CI pipeline infrastructure (Jenkins controllers, agent nodes, artifact storage) is fully operational and can be modified without additional procurement or administrative approval delays.
The Spring Cloud Stream and Spring Cloud Data Flow repository structures are already set up to accept new module contributions, with no required repository restructuring.

activities.activity_name: U1: Runtime Info Shell Command Development
activities.activity_description: Implement the s-c-d shell command to output module runtime details (host, port, etc.), including input argument parsing, runtime info collection logic, and formatted console output. Include unit tests for command functionality.

activities.activity_name: U2: YARN Data Flow Deployer Implementation
activities.activity_description: Develop the YARN deployer for data flow workloads, including YARN application packaging, resource configuration handling, deployment lifecycle management (deploy, undeploy, scale), and integration testing against a test YARN cluster.

activities.activity_name: U3: XD File Module Port to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Port the legacy XD file module to the Spring Cloud Stream repository, adapt the module to the current s-c-s module API and binder conventions, and add unit and integration tests to validate functionality.

activities.activity_name: U4: Build Lifecycle Split for SPI Deployers
activities.activity_description: Refactor the existing Maven build configuration to separate the admin module build from individual SPI deployer builds, implement Maven profiles to enable individual deployer bundling, and validate all build profiles produce correct artifacts.

Audit the entire codebase for usages of XDRuntimeException, replace all instances with appropriate Spring standard runtime exceptions, and update all dependent code, error handling logic, and tests to align with the new exception types.

Update the existing Gemfire sink module to the latest released version, validate compatibility with the current Spring Cloud Stream binder version, and add integration tests for Gemfire connectivity and data landing functionality.

activities.activity_name: U7: SFTP Source Module Development and Publication
activities.activity_description: Develop the SFTP source module following Spring Cloud Stream source module conventions, register it as an OOTB module in the module list, publish the module artifacts to the target Maven snapshot repository, and validate end-to-end streaming pipeline functionality with the new module.

activities.activity_name: U8: CI Pipeline Gaps Resolution for Data Flow Family
activities.activity_description: Identify and resolve remaining CI pipeline gaps for Spring Cloud Data Flow and related projects, including adding missing test jobs, artifact validation steps, and commit-triggered functional test runs to ensure continuous evaluation of functionality on every commit.
